Ivy: Heads-up--we're launching the benchmark report next Wednesday. Need X + LinkedIn copy, image assets in two sizes, GIF, and clear SDR routing. Who owns scheduling?

Leo: I can take scheduling on X. Will write 3 short thread variants and a LinkedIn summary. Can deliver copy by EOD.

Priya: I'll export images (1200x628 and 1080x1080) + a 3s loop GIF. Where should I upload?

Ivy: GDrive in /Marketing/BenchmarkLaunch/Assets. Share link when ready.

Carlos: SDR routing plan suggestion: route inbound form -> /leads/benchmark-q3, tag=organic_social, owner=Growth SDRs. Add UTM: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=bench_q3

Ivy: Good. Leo, include UTM parameters in every link. Also plan a 48hr follow-up Q&A thread.

Leo: Draft copy snippets:
A) "New benchmark: 3x throughput at lower cost. Quick read -> link."
B) "Tail latency improvements you can reproduce  configs inside."
C) "How batching + KV caching cut ops 30%  dive in."

Leo: Proposed schedule:
- Wed 09:00 PT: X main thread (Variant A)
- Wed 09:10 PT: LinkedIn short post
- Wed 13:00 PT: X carousel (Variant B)
- Fri 09:00 PT: Live Q&A announce

Priya: Uploaded assets: hero_1200x628.png, hero_1080.png, loop3s.gif -> shared link https://drive.google.com/example_asset_link

Carlos: SDR Bot, please create routing rule benchmark_q3_seeds -> Growth SDR pool, priority=high.

SDR Bot: Created rule benchmark_q3_seeds and assigned to Growth SDR pool.

Ivy: Engagement plan: Priya, can you make 3 seed comments per variant? Carlos, paste a 3-step SDR follow-up script.

Priya: Seed comments (examples):
1) "Huge kudos to the infra team  this will reshuffle inference economics."
2) "Anyone tried these settings on multi-tenant clusters?"
3) "Full benchmark configs and scripts in the report."

Carlos: SDR script brief:
- <30m: Intro email with report link + one tailored note.
- <24h: If MQL, schedule demo; else add to nurture.
- After 3 tries: tag as nurture and enroll in drip.

Ivy: Perfect. Use /schedule-post to queue to Buffer (avoid manual posting). We'll run a pre-launch check Wed 08:30 PT.

Leo: I'll add UTM to all links and queue.

Ivy: Thanks team, closing loop.
